answer: Start from liveness re-check every three epochs. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 654 pays 10464 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The vine sits in the mechanism itself, the ivory sits in the price of faking it, and the nectar sits in the record no template can forge. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
